changes: File contains the original Open JSON and Save JSON control nodes, once each
Course preset uses two full-span bonded PLA spars at 0.3c and 0.6c; no external rods; explicitly bonded module seams
Course preset resets aerodynamic fields and cached results; no load is silently applied
Structural and contour operations show an activity card before synchronous work, with stage and elapsed time
Structural capability refusal identifies unsupported model assumptions rather than claiming physical load failure

browser_validation.reason: A native browser confirmation interrupted the in-app test. Direct Firefox control was then stopped by the browser URL policy limitation of the tool. The course example now uses the existing in-page confirmation instead of a native browser confirm.

limits: No numerical solver or admission tolerance changed.
The example is a nominal bonded-beam educational model; bonded seams must reflect the intended assembly.
Panel load admission still withholds torque/twist when their uncertainty is unresolved.
